data.body: HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-11 (PST): CLOSED (class preexisting) through the completion gate. Fix merged as Gerrit 3356 at `d779ed59793`. Root cause: every bounded git call reached git through `gitutil.run_git(..., timeout=)` → `subprocess.run`, whose timeout SIGKILLs only git itself. `run_git` now runs any call that has a timeout in its own process group (`_run_in_group`, which takes subprocess.run's keywords) and reaps the group SIGTERM first. `run_git_reaped` delegates to it. Test `tests/unit/test_bounded_git_group_reap.py` fails on the pre-fix code: the `.keep` stays behind. Note for future tests: a test that fakes `subprocess.run` for a bounded git call must also patch `gitutil._run_in_group`. 15 test files were updated that way. Nothing is left open on this ticket.
